messages:
Maria CS: FYI customer reports 403s on /v1/embeddings after rotating a service key. Generation endpoints still work, but embeddings/rerank return 403 with 'missing scope: embeddings'. attaching their repro below.

Sam Support: Can you share the customer id and their repro (curl + response)? I'll triage.

Maria CS: Customer id: tenant-acme-42. Their curl + response: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 403
```json
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scopes: embeddings","required":["embeddings"]}
```
They say portal shows the token has embeddings and chat scopes.

Devin Eng: Can you dump the token claims (decoded JWT) or full header string the customer used? Might be a delimiter/encoding issue.

Maria CS: Pasted the decoded claim the customer provided (they pasted only the claims section):
```json
{"sub":"svcacct:acme:deploy","scope":"chat:generate\u00A0embeddings\u00A0rerank","exp":1760000000}
```
Note: the middle separators above are non-breaking spaces (U+00A0) per their copy-paste.

Priya SRE: That explains it — our auth middleware splits scopes on ASCII space (0x20) and commas, but not NBSP (U+00A0). If a provisioning flow copies scopes from some UI and inserts NBSPs (or the customer's tooling did), the effective scope list becomes one token containing NBSPs and doesn't match. We've seen similar with some proxies that normalize/escape spaces.

Devin Eng: Repro steps for us: create a token whose scope claim uses NBSP between scopes and call embeddings endpoint. Quick curl: 
```bash
# reproduce header with NBSP (utf-8)
TOKEN="ey...payload-with-\u00C2\u00A0-encoded-scopes..."
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"x"}'
```
Expect 403 with missing embeddings.

Priya SRE: Short-term mitigations:
- Ask customer to re-issue/rotate the key and copy scopes using the CLI or the REST API instead of the UI copy that introduced NBSPs. CLI will normalize spaces.
- Our proxy/ingress team can add a normalization layer to trim/replace NBSPs in the Authorization header before auth checks. I'll file infra ticket if we want to patch.

rotation-bot: Suggested quick admin command for customer: 
```bash
redwood admin tokens rotate --tenant acme-42 --scopes "chat:generate embeddings rerank"
```
This produces a clean token with ASCII spaces.

Sam Support: I passed repro and workaround to the customer. They rotated via CLI and confirmed embeddings calls now succeed. They also said the UI copy still produces NBSP when copying from certain browsers.

Priya SRE: I'll open infra ticket (INGRESS-1287) to add a normalization filter for common non-ASCII separators and log if we detect NBSP in incoming auth headers. Tagging @Devin Eng to review the auth middleware change.

Maria CS: Closing on customer side — they validated and are unblocked. Leaving infra ticket to you folks. Thanks :tada:

Devin Eng: Noted. Will review middleware patch and aim for a small canary change.

Sam Support: Marking as resolved in the ticketing system.
